message:
The tobacco settlement now being discussed in Congress sucks! For 62 million smokers it means the largest tax hikes we’ve seen in our life times. Studies show that half of us make under $30,000 per yr. Cigarettes just went up $1.00 carton a few months ago. I dropped our Delta Dental in Dec. If we’re taxed $1.50 per pack, that means $150. per mo. for us or $1,800. a yr. Calf. wants more taxes on top of that! We’ll have to drop our medical insurer.

Tobacco companies better get back on the offensive (like the liquor companies) and do studies on the many benefits of smoking. We all know about the health risks!
